scope: Exactly four saved references; one AB finder-center line per QR; 12 lines total.

method.detection: Per-QR Otsu inverse threshold; outer/white/inner nested contours; convex quadrilateral outer-ring corners.
method.corner_refinement: OpenCV cornerSubPix on raw grayscale QR crop; no image warp or smoothing added.
method.center: Intersection of the two diagonals of the refined OUTER finder quadrilateral.
method.line: Unique line through A(top-left finder center) and B(top-right finder center). C identifies layout only.
method.units: Original image x right/y down; atan2(dy,dx) in degrees, NOT robot theta.
method.precision_note: Detection/iteration settings and decimal output are not physical-accuracy thresholds.
method.aggregation: No averaging of QR, references, nested rings or outer-border slopes.

limitations: Finder-center baseline is a new feature, not the same line as the former QR outer top border.
Single image per saved reference; no uncertainty/equivalence or motion-response claim.
Two estimated centers always determine a line; zero residual to those two points does not prove accurate detection.
Illumination, printed pattern geometry, sampling, blur and lens distortion can bias corners.
No first/second/third movement images, new theta calibration or controller changes were processed.
